name: skillsentra-for-chatgpt
description: Govern exact Agent Skill versions and context-bound proposals from ChatGPT through SkillSentra.

interface.longDescription: SKillSentra for Chatgpt helps builders discover, inspect, evaluate, and improve exact versions of Agent Skills. It reads versioned context and evidence through a controlled MCP connection. State-changing tools require explicit confirmation and create auditable records. It does not automatically install or run downloaded Skills, apply updates, accept proposals, publish versions, deploy software, process payments, or authorize releases. This independent integration is not made or endorsed by OpenAI.
defaultPrompt: Search for a Skill for drafting a technical report and show its evidence level.
Show the current version, evidence and open risks for my Skill project.
Review a pending collaboration request I select and draft a bounded proposal.
